svg.title: Two hal/write exchanges
svg.desc: A client sends hal/write for desk-fan fan_speed 150 percent. The hub answers error -32010 LIMIT_EXCEEDED, fan_speed 150 percent exceeds the limit of 100 percent, from desk-fan.hal.yaml confirmed by sohan on 2026-10-24. The client sends hal/write for 60 percent, and the hub answers with a result of status done, value 60, unit percent.
